name: Gate B12
description: Boarding gate B12 is used for many international flights in Terminal 1.
opening_hours: Follows flight schedule. Staffed about 2 hours before departure.
direction_text: From check-in, go through security. Follow signs for pier B. Gate B12 is about 8 minutes walk.
accessibility: Step-free route. Seating and a wheelchair waiting point are next to the gate.
assistance_contact: Special assistance desk, Terminal 1 arrivals, phone +44 0000 111 201

name: Gate A5
description: Boarding gate A5 is mainly used for domestic and short-haul flights.
direction_text: After security turn left for pier A. Gate A5 is near the start of the pier.
accessibility: Step-free. Hearing loop at the desk.
assistance_contact: Special assistance desk, Terminal 1 arrivals, phone +44 0000 111 201

name: Gate C8
description: Boarding gate C8 is in Terminal 2 for long-haul and some charter flights.
direction_text: In Terminal 2 departures, follow pier C signs. Gate C8 is at the far end of the pier (about 10 minutes).
accessibility: Moving walkways on the pier. Step-free.

name: Terminal 1 check-in area
description: Airline check-in desks and bag drop for Terminal 1 flights. Self-service kiosks are in the middle of the hall.
opening_hours: 04:00 to 22:00 daily. Some desks open later for the last wave of flights.
direction_text: Enter Terminal 1 and go up one level to departures. Desks are grouped by airline on the overhead screens.
accessibility: Lifts from the forecourt. Lowered kiosks and a wheelchair lane.

name: Terminal 2 check-in area
description: Check-in and bag drop for Terminal 2, including many international airlines.
direction_text: From the train station follow Terminal 2 departures. Check-in is on level 1.
accessibility: Step-free from the train. Assistance meeting point by door 2.

name: Terminal 1 baggage claim
description: Baggage reclaim for Terminal 1 arrivals. Belt numbers are shown on the screens above each carousel.
opening_hours: Open for arriving flights, usually 05:00 to 00:30.
direction_text: After passport control follow Baggage Reclaim. Oversized bags are collected at the side desk.
accessibility: Step-free. Seating between belts. Staff can help with heavy bags if you ask.

name: Terminal 2 baggage claim
description: Baggage reclaim for Terminal 2. Customs is after the belts.
direction_text: Follow Arrivals then Baggage Reclaim. After you pick up bags, exit through customs to the meeting point.
accessibility: Step-free. Assistance staff wait by belt 7 if you booked help.

name: Terminal 1 security control
description: Passenger security screening for Terminal 1. Liquids must be in 100ml bottles in one clear bag.
direction_text: From check-in walk straight to Security. Fast track is on the right if your ticket includes it.
accessibility: A wider lane and a private search room are available. Tell a staff member if you cannot lift bags.

name: Terminal 2 security control
description: Passenger security screening for Terminal 2, including body scanners.
direction_text: After you drop bags, follow Security / Departures. Family lane is signed on the left.
accessibility: Accessible lane. You can request a pat-down instead of the scanner.

name: Terminal 1 information desk
description: Staffed desk for directions, flight questions and airport maps. This is not the airline desk.
direction_text: In the Terminal 1 arrivals hall look for the yellow i sign in the middle of the hall.
accessibility: Lowered counter. Induction loop. Large-print maps on request.

name: Terminal 2 information desk
description: Staffed desk for Terminal 2 maps, transport and meeting points.
direction_text: After baggage claim, the information desk is on the right before the main exit.
accessibility: Lowered counter. Written notes available if you prefer not to speak.

name: Lost and found office
description: Report or collect items lost in the terminals or on the airside corridors. Airline cabin items are usually with the airline first.
direction_text: Go to Terminal 1 arrivals. Follow Lost Property signs beside belt 1.
accessibility: Step-free. You can also report online if you cannot visit.

name: Riverside Lounge
description: Pay-in or membership lounge with seats, snacks and showers. Not an airline-only lounge.
direction_text: After Terminal 2 security turn towards pier C. The lounge door is opposite gate C2.
accessibility: Step-free. Accessible toilet and shower. Quiet corner available.

name: Multi-faith prayer room
description: Quiet room for prayer and reflection. Washing facilities are next door. Open to all passengers.
opening_hours: 24 hours when the terminal is open.
direction_text: After Terminal 1 security follow the chapel / prayer room sign towards pier A.
accessibility: Step-free. Chairs and floor space. Companion is welcome.
assistance_contact: Chaplaincy via information desk T1, phone +44 0000 111 100

name: Food court Terminal 1
description: Several cafes and a sit-down restaurant after security in Terminal 1.
opening_hours: Most outlets 05:00 to 21:30. One cafe stays open for late flights.
direction_text: After security walk to the large seating area. Food outlets are around the court.
accessibility: Movable chairs. Allergy information at each counter.
assistance_contact: Retail help via information desk T1

name: Coffee shop Terminal 2
description: Coffee and light snacks. Takeaway cups are available.
direction_text: After Terminal 2 security, the coffee shop is on the left before pier C.
accessibility: Counter service. Staff can bring drinks to a table if you ask.
assistance_contact: Retail help via information desk T2

name: Airport train station
description: Trains to the city centre (about 25 minutes). Tickets from the machines or the staffed booth.
direction_text: From Terminal 2 arrivals follow Train / Rail. From Terminal 1 take the free shuttle to Terminal 2 first (8 minutes).
accessibility: Lifts to platforms. Level boarding on most trains. Assistance can be booked with the rail operator.

name: Taxi pickup zone
description: Official airport taxi queue. Do not accept rides from people inside the hall.
direction_text: Exit Terminal 1 arrivals at door 4 and join the signed taxi queue. Terminal 2 taxis are outside door 1.
accessibility: Wheelchair-accessible taxis are in a separate short queue. Ask the marshal.

name: Special assistance desk
description: Help for passengers with reduced mobility, hidden disabilities or who need a wheelchair through the airport.
opening_hours: 04:00 to 23:30 daily. Please book 48 hours ahead with your airline if you can.
direction_text: Meet staff at the sunflower sign in Terminal 1 arrivals or at door 2 in Terminal 2.
accessibility: This desk is the main accessibility service. Hidden disability lanyards are available here.

name: Restrooms Terminal 1 departures
floor_or_zone: After security, next to the food court
description: Public toilets including an accessible cubicle and a baby-change room.
opening_hours: Open while the terminal is open.
direction_text: After security, toilets are signed beside the food court and again on pier B.
accessibility: Accessible toilet with alarm. Changing Places room is next to the information desk landside.
assistance_contact: Cleaning / access via information desk T1

name: Airport pharmacy
description: Over-the-counter medicine and basic travel health items. Not a full hospital.
direction_text: In Terminal 1 arrivals, the pharmacy is opposite the information desk.
accessibility: Step-free. Pharmacist can come to the counter edge if needed.

name: First aid room
description: Nurse-led first aid for passengers. For a serious emergency use an airport phone and ask for medical help.
opening_hours: 06:00 to 22:00. Outside these hours ask any staff member.
direction_text: Ask at the Terminal 1 information desk. They will walk you to the first aid room.
accessibility: Step-free. Trolley access.
assistance_contact: In emergency call 999 from a UK phone or use a red airport help point

name: Currency exchange
description: Cash exchange and prepaid travel cards. Rates are on the board. This is not an ATM-only booth.
direction_text: Landside booth is in Terminal 2 arrivals. Airside booth is after security near the shops.
accessibility: Lowered counter at the arrivals booth.

name: Car rental desks
floor_or_zone: Arrivals, far left after the doors
description: Main rental brands have desks in Terminal 2. Shuttle buses go to the rental car park.
direction_text: From Terminal 2 arrivals walk left to the rental hall. From Terminal 1 take the shuttle to Terminal 2.
accessibility: Adapted vehicles must be booked in advance with the rental company.

name: Short stay parking
description: Short stay car park linked to Terminal 1 by a covered walkway. Pay at the machines before you return to the car.
direction_text: Follow P1 Short Stay. Pedestrian bridge goes into Terminal 1 departures.
accessibility: Blue badge bays on level 1 near the lift. Max headroom 2.1m.
